directory.indexMetaDescription: Snirem isebtar izayezen n tqeddimin n SwapSpot s taggayt d usuq n tmnaḍt. Af aṣfu, asleḥ, annuqel, tisirin, taḥrazt n yiɣersiwen, lǧmal, tiqeddimin tiprufesyunalin d wayen nniḍen.
directory.indexTitle: Tiqeddimin n yimɛiwnen n tmnaḍt s taggayt d usuq
directory.indexIntro: Isebtar-agi ttwasnulfun seg tqeddimin n yimɛiwnen i d-yettwasuffɣen deg SwapSpot. Ttɛawnen iklyanen ad afen tiskanin n tidett n tqeddimin s temdint, tangalt n lbusta, lḥuma, taggayt, ssuma, tutlayt d uktazal.
directory.statPages: isebtar n taggayt d usuq i yellan
directory.byCountryBody: Yal aseɣwen sdaw yeldi asebter azayez. Mi ara d-yessuffeɣ umɛiwen tamnaḍt n umahil tamaynut, ad d-tban dagi mi ara yettwaleqqem lkac n usmel.
directory.emptyBody: Tebdart tettwabna seg tqeddimin n yimɛiwnen i d-yettwasuffɣen. Ma ulac iseɣwan dagi yakan, uɣal-d ticki neɣ ldi asnas i wakken ad tsnirmeḍ imɛiwnen yezgan ɣer-k.
directory.pairMetaDescription: Af imɛiwnen n {categoryLower} deg {market}. Qarren tiskanin tizayezin n tqeddimin, tamnaḍin n umahil, ssuma, tutlayin d uktazal send ad teldiḍ SwapSpot.

directory.pairSummary: Qarren tiskanin tizayezin n tqeddimin n {categoryLower} seg yimɛiwnen n tmnaḍt ɣer {market}. Seqdec asnas mi ara tiliḍ tewjdeḍ ad tazneḍ izen, ad tsutreḍ asiweḍ n ssuma neɣ ad tḥejzeḍ.
directory.popularTitle: Ayen i izemren medden ad afen deg {market}
directory.popularBody: Tiqeddimin-agi d-ttalint seg yimaɣnuten n yimɛiwnen i d-yettwasuffɣen, mačči seg tebdart n usnerni ur tettbeddil ara.
directory.areaTitle: Tamnaḍt n tmnaḍt, mačči tansa n tidett
directory.areaBody: Isebtar izayezen sskanen lḥuma, tingalin n lbusta, temdinin d radyus n umahil i wakken iklyanen ad afen tallalt yezgan war ma ttwabeggnent tansiwin tuffiren.
directory.namesTitle: Isemmen n tqeddimin yewjden i unadi
directory.namesBody: Tiqeddimin n yimɛiwnen ttwasenfalen ɣer yisemmaden ittwaneddan, awalen n tmnaḍt d isebtar n taggayt akken iklyanen ad nadin s tmahilin n tidett i ḥwaǧen.
directory.inAppTitle: Asqerdec d uḥjez qqimen deg usnas
directory.inAppBody: Asmel yettɛawan medden ad afen tiqeddimin. SwapSpot teḥrez isiweḍen n ssuma, iznan, iḥjezen, isenqaden d usewḥel deg usnas n tiliɣri.
directory.pairFaq1Q: Zemreɣ ad ḥjezeɣ imɛiwnen n {categoryLower} deg {market} ɣef usebter-agi?
directory.pairFaq1A: Asebter-agi n usmel d tiskant tazayezt i unadi. Sider SwapSpot i wakken ad tazneḍ iznan i yimɛiwnen, ad tsutreḍ isiweḍen n ssuma, ad tebḍuḍ tansiwin n tidett akked usefrek n yiḥjezen.
directory.pairFaq2Q: Tansiwin n yimɛiwnen n tidett d tizayezin?
directory.pairFaq2A: Ala. SwapSpot teskan tamnaḍin n umahil s wudem aqriban am tengalin n lbusta, lḥuma, temdinin neɣ radyus. Tansiwin n tidett qqimen d tuffirin, tzemreḍ ad tebḍuḍ-itent deg usqerdec kan mi ara ilin snat n yiḥricen ttewjden.
directory.pairFaq3A: Ala. Imɛiwnen zemren ad snulfun amaɣnu, ad ssuffɣen tiqeddimin war lɛumula neɣ aḥric seg SwapSpot. Iklyanen ttxellsen i unekcum mi ara bɣun ad azen iznan, ad suturen isiweḍen n ssuma neɣ ad ḥjezen.

directory.cardsBody: Qarren tiqeddimin, ssuma, tamnaḍin, tutlayin, uktazal d tarmit n yimɛiwnen ɣer {market}. Tansiwin n tidett d unermes uslig qqimen deg SwapSpot.

directory.noCommissionBody: Imɛiwnen ṭṭfen axellaṣ n tmahilin. SwapSpot ur d-tettawi ara aḥric neɣ lɛumula seg umahil n yimɛiwnen.
directory.servicesBody: Ay-agi d tiskanin n tqeddimin i d-yettwasuffɣen deg SwapSpot. Ssuma tezmer ad tili tuḥedden, s tsaɛt, seg uzwir, neɣ s usuter ɣef tmahilt.
directory.serviceFallback: Ldi SwapSpot i wakken ad twaliḍ tqeddimt-agi, ad tsutreḍ talɣut sakin ad tsentmeḍ ayen ara yettwaxdem send aḥjez.
directory.areasBody: Isebtar n yimɛiwnen izayezen ttefken i yimsekkilen n unadi d yiklyanen aṭas n talɣut: isemmen n tqeddimin, lḥuma, temdinin, tamnaḍin n umahil s wudem aqriban d yimatar n tutlayt. Talɣut n unermes tideg qqimen deg SwapSpot.
directory.continueTitle: Azen iznan, suter isiweḍen n ssuma, sakin ḥjez s usenqed n tbaḍnit.
directory.helperFaq1A: Ldi SwapSpot i wakken ad tazneḍ izen i umɛiwen, ad tsutreḍ asiweḍ n ssuma, ad tebḍuḍ talɣut n umahil, sakin ad tessefrekeḍ aḥjez s taɣellist deg usnas.
directory.helperFaq2A: Ala. Isebtar izayezen sskanen tamnaḍin n umahil s wudem aqriban am lḥuma, temdinin, tengalin n lbusta neɣ radyus. Tansiwin n tidett qqimen d tuffirin armi bḍan-itent yimseqdacen deg usqerdec.
directory.helperFaq3A: Ala. Imɛiwnen zemren ad ssuffɣen tiqeddimin war ma SwapSpot ad tettawi lɛumula neɣ aḥric seg yixellaṣen n tmahilin-nsen.

cookieConsent.body: Nseqdac inagan n tuqqna n Google Analytics i wakken ad nefhem inekcumen d ad nsnerni SwapSpot. Tzemreḍ ad tqebleḍ neɣ ad tugiḍ inagan n tasleḍt d afrayan.
maintenance.text: SwapSpot tettnuqqel ɣer iqeddacen imaynuten. Ɣef kra n tsaɛt, tuqqna, usbadu n wawal uffir d ibeddilen n umiḍan zemren ur ddun ara. Ma ulac aɣilif, ɛreḍ tikkelt-nniḍen ɣef kra n lweqt.

reset.invalid: Aseɣwen n usbadu-agi ur ittwasentem ara neɣ yekfa. Suter amaynut seg usnas.
